name: Хурлын тэмдэглэл
description: Компанийн хурлын тэмдэглэлийн стандарт загвар: ерөнхий мэдээлэл, хэлэлцсэн асуудлууд, үндсэн шийдвэр, даалгаврын хүснэгт.

sections.title: Хурлын ерөнхий мэдээлэл
sections.instruction: Start with a one-line italic subtitle describing what the meeting was about. Then output a two-column Markdown table with these rows: 'Огноо' (the meeting date if stated in the transcript), 'Зорилго' (the meeting's main objective, one short phrase), and 'Оролцогчид' (the participants or teams present). Use only information stated in the transcript; leave a cell as '—' if it was not mentioned.

sections.title: Хэлэлцсэн асуудлууд
sections.instruction: Break the meeting into its main discussion topics in the order they were discussed. Give each topic a bold sub-heading and summarize its key points, figures, costs, options, deadlines, and technical details. When the transcript contains structured data (prices, plan tiers, specifications, credentials, step-by-step processes), present it as a Markdown table or a numbered list under that topic. Cover every substantive topic; never invent facts not in the transcript.

sections.title: Үндсэн шийдвэр, тохиролцоо
sections.instruction: List the concrete decisions and agreements the meeting reached, as a numbered list. Each item is one clear, specific sentence (include dates, amounts, or names where they were decided).

sections.title: Даалгавар, хариуцагчид
sections.instruction: List every task that was explicitly assigned, as a Markdown table. Columns: '№' (sequential number), 'Даалгавар' (the task), 'Хариуцагч' (the person or people responsible), 'Хугацаа' (the deadline or timing — a date, or wording like 'Шуурхай' / 'Credentials авмагц' if that is what was said). Include only tasks with a clear owner or deadline from the transcript.

sections.title: Тэмдэглэл хөтөлсөн
sections.instruction: If the transcript identifies who took the notes or ran the meeting, write their name here. Otherwise output '—'.
